verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a personal-agent service that stores user data, but nothing in the evidence documents a data export, an open-format download, or an account-exit process. Per-user isolated storage and an OpenAPI spec with /v1/users/* paths describe architecture and developer building blocks, not a user-facing export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
